quote: After milling for violet pigment 40 times, 17 of those got me ruby pigment.
notes: Original first-person WotLK-era beta build 8885 report (later commenter says mechanics changed by beta 8905). 40 completed five-herb mills for violet-tier pigments, 17 Ruby-positive mills, 19 Ruby units total, exactly one 3-unit Ruby outcome. Arithmetic reconciliation of the explicitly stated complete 40/17/19 figures yields 23 zero-Ruby, 16 one-Ruby and one three-Ruby outcome; this is a derived exact histogram from source counts, not a new measured cohort and not current Retail. Individual herb input IDs, skill, specialization, refunds and date missing; keep separate from commenter 180977 PTR study.
